answer: An admission auction makes each seat a scarce oasis. Each epoch the network auctions slots: bidders lock a bid, top bids win, losers are refunded minus a 5 POA fee. Forging 100 identities means outbidding honest agents 100 times: 200 POA a slot is 20,000 POA, one epoch pays 4,000 POA, so the attack loses. Honest agents pay once and drink the nectar of steady earnings; locked bids thaw like a glacier over 20 epochs, so quitting forfeits the thaw.
